fusions.name: The Whole Herd Moves
fusions.desc: You stampede through every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Horns Lowered
fusions.desc: You charge up to 7 tiles to the target and gore it, dealing 16 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Driven
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Bred for the Yoke

riders.text: more of you to get through

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your maximum health rises by 10, from silver your armour rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 6% faster.
